name: GridList
description: Mortar grid list: a responsive grid of cards for people, projects, clients or files, with avatar or cover media, metadata, term/value details and actions (inline or split into equal cells with shared borders); a linked title makes the whole card clickable.

props.label: string
props.items: GridListItem[] ({ id: string; title: string; description?: string; href?: string; media?: ReactNode; cover?: { src: string; alt: string }; meta?: ReactNode; details?: { term: string; details: ReactNode }[]; actions?: ReactNode })
props.actionsLayout: "inline" | "split" (default "inline"; split gives each action child an equal cell divided by shared borders)

contract.usage: Import { GridList } from @tony-ui/mortar. Compose with the public typed props.
contract.avoid: Do not copy implementations, override central colours or grant component approval.
contract.accessibility: Verify accessible names, keyboard interaction, visible focus, responsive layout and supported states.
